description.value: Lionsgate Pizza is a North Vancouver institution that has been serving gourmet pizza since 1989, evolving from the original Raven Pizza tradition dating back to 1979. The kitchen makes dough and slow-simmered sauce from scratch daily, using local BC cheese, fresh vegetables, and artisan meats sourced from a North Shore supplier. Specialty pizzas, Italian pastas, and gluten-free crusts are all on the menu.
